sections.heading: 1. Ease the jaw and neck
lines: ① Check: teeth touching? Let them part.
② Roll your shoulders back 5 times, hourly.
③ Tuck your chin, turn side to side 5 times.
④ Before bed: slow circles in front of the ear.

sections.heading: 2. Stop and get checked if…
lines: Your jaw locks or eating gets hard,
or your face feels numb — stop and get advice.

caption:
Quick check: are your teeth touching right now? During deadline week, Mr Turtle was clenching all day without noticing.

The jaw, neck and upper shoulders share muscles and nerves, so tension in one often shows up in the others. Stress, long screen days and poor sleep can all add to it.

A resting jaw looks like this: lips gently closed, teeth apart, tongue on the roof of your mouth. Hourly shoulder rolls, gentle chin tucks and slow breathing before bed can help.

If your jaw locks or eating gets hard, see your dentist or GP. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can assess your neck, jaw and upper back together. Book online via the link in bio.
